xna-type.name: BuildXact
xna-type.summary: An MSBuild task that provides incremental build capabilities for XACT projects.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of BuildXact.

property.name: BuildConfiguration
property.summary: Gets or sets the content build configuration name.

property.name: IntermediateDirectory
property.summary: Gets or sets the directory for storing temporary build files.

property.name: IntermediateFiles
property.summary: Gets the names of the intermediate files used internally by the build.
property.remarks: When combined with OutputXactFiles , this property gives the complete list of generated files that should be removed by a Clean build operation.

property.name: LoggerRootDirectory
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.remarks: When building XACT content, all errors are displayed in the Error List Window of Visual Studio. Along with the data that triggered the error, the Error List displays the path and filename where the offending data was encountered. By default, the path of the offending file that is reported in the Error List is always expressed as relative to the location of the project file that references it. When set, the LoggerRootDirectory property specifies an explicit base path for error reporting that overrides the default operation. All offending files reported in the Error List will be expressed as relative to the base path set in LoggerRootDirectory.

property.name: OutputDirectory
property.summary: Gets or sets the directory for the final build results.

property.name: OutputXactFiles
property.summary: Gets the names of all files produced by the build, regardless of any incremental optimizations.
property.remarks: Pass this property value to a subsequent packfile generator task or combine with the IntermediateFiles property to get a complete list of generated files that should be removed by a Clean build operation.

property.name: RebuildAll
property.summary: Gets or sets the force rebuild flag.

property.name: RebuiltXactFiles
property.summary: Gets the names of files modified by an incremental rebuild.
property.remarks: Optimize your deploy or reload process by passing the current value of RebuiltXactFiles to a subsequent incremental deploy or reload notification task.

property.name: RootDirectory
property.summary: Gets or sets the base directory for the entire content build process.

property.name: TargetPlatform
property.summary: Gets or sets the content build target platform.

property.name: TargetProfile
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.

property.name: XactProjects
property.summary: Gets or sets the XACT project files to be built.

property.name: XnaFrameworkVersion
property.summary: Gets or sets XNA framework version, used to determine the xactbld.exe path.

overload.returns: true to begin execution of the task; otherwise false.
